newsitem.title: USA: Abaco Grupo offers $0.30/shr for rest of Rodman.
newsitem.headline: Abaco Grupo offers $0.30/shr for rest of Rodman.

text.p: Abaco Grupo Financiero S.A. de C.V., a Mexican financial services company, said it is offering to pay $0.30 per share to shareholders of Rodman & Renshaw Capital Group Inc for all Rodman common shares it does not presently own.
Abaco currently owns 69.6 percent of Rodman's 6,645,802 outstanding shares of common stock.

Abaco acquired a controlling interest in Rodman in December 1993 at a time when the U.S. brokerage firm was undergoing managerial and financial difficulties, Abaco said in a statement released on Tuesday.
Officials of Rodman & Renshaw were not immediately available to comment on or respond to the offer.
Abaco said it has extended its commitment to support unconditionally Rodman & Renshaw Capital Group and its subsidiary, Rodman & Renshaw Inc, through March 31, 1999.

This support may include, subject to approval by Mexican regulatory authorities, guarantees, infusions of capital, conversion of short-term debt to long-term debt, and conversion of short- or long-term debt to equity, if required, to continue to sustain and grow Rodman's operations and allow it to meet net capital requirements, Abaco said.

Abaco is a large Mexican financial services group which includes Abaco Casa de Bolsa, a securities brokerage firm with offices in major Mexican cities and Confia, a commercial bank with more than 300 branches.

Rodman & Renshaw provides investment banking, equity, fixed-income and research services to both institutional and individual investors. The firm has five U.S. offices in Chicago, New York, Boston, Dallas and San Francisco.
